title: Military like Feild I see with black shipping containers.
content: AI would not work well on this , i am going to try another program and repost. But there is a fields that looks like a old abandoned football field that has now turned into a military storage , it has a huge barbed wire fence that’s silver, military vehicles driving around, spotlights and guards . But they have this big black shipping containers in grids of rows all stacked on top of each other . I always feel fear, that I am running and trying to hide when I am here.
